name: creator
description: Create portal: a de-privileged app frame that mints a dDRM asset on PQ custody. Drives encrypt-provider (seal_inline_threshold), publish-provider (prepare_publish), and the host-mediated wallet-sign and chain-broadcast capabilities. Swaps the Lit CEK system for the dKMS threshold escrow (cenc:elastos-pq-hybrid-threshold-v0); holds no keys, no chain RPC, no wallet.
author: elastos

interfaces.description: Seal source bytes under PQ-hybrid threshold custody and prepare a publish record

methods.description: Mint a dDRM asset: seal_inline_threshold + prepare_publish, host-mediated wallet sign and chain broadcast
